section_summary.extract_value: This abstract describes a single study (Study X) examining the association between consideration of cosmetic surgery, body appreciation, media influence, and demographics among 322 female university students. Participants completed the Consider subscale of the Acceptance of Cosmetic Surgery Scale, the SATAQ-3, and the Body Appreciation Scale (BAS), with results showing that consideration of cosmetic surgery was negatively correlated with BAS scores, age, and BMI.
